mainEntity.name: How do you measure the success of a topic cluster strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The success of a topic cluster strategy is measured through various SEO metrics. Key indicators include improvements in organic traffic to both pillar and cluster pages, higher rankings for targeted keywords, increased domain authority, and a reduction in bounce rates. You should also track user engagement metrics like time on page, pages per session, and conversions. Monitoring internal link clicks and the overall growth in your website's share of voice for specific topics also provides valuable insight into the strategy's effectiveness and impact on your online presence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Success is measured by increased organic traffic, higher rankings, improved domain authority, reduced bounce rates, and better user engagement (time on page, conversions).
